access_requests_enabled.description: Whether the organization permits access requests from users who are not members of the organization.

created_at.description: The time the organization was created.

group_id.description: The Snyk ID of the group to which the organization belongs.

is_personal.description: Whether the organization is independent (that is, not part of a group).

name.description: The display name of the organization.

slug.description: The canonical (unique and URL-friendly) name of the organization.

updated_at.description: The time the organization was last modified.
